stem: An engine is operating at 25% of its full power. Which number line shows a point that represents 25%?

options.label: F
options.text: Number line with a point at 3/10

options.label: G
options.text: Number line with a point at 2/10

options.label: H
options.text: Number line with a point at 4/10

options.label: J
options.text: Number line with a point at 5/10

visual_elements: Four number lines labeled F, G, H, J with points marked: F at 3 ticks out of 10, G at 2 ticks out of 10, H at 4 ticks out of 10, J at 5 ticks out of 10 between 0 and 1.
notes: The correct answer is G as 25% corresponds to 0.25, or 2.5 ticks out of 10, closest to 2 ticks for this discrete choice.
